definitions.title: Probability Density Function (PDF)
definitions.latex: f(x) \ge 0 \quad \forall x, \quad \int_{-\infty}^\infty f(x) dx = 1, \quad P(a \le X \le b) = \int_a^b f(x) dx
definitions.statement: A probability density function f(x) models a continuous random variable X. The probability that X falls in [a, b] is the definite integral of f(x) over [a, b].
conditions: Total integral over real line equals 1
definitions.explanation: Continuous probability is represented by area under the curve rather than discrete point values.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Total area under any valid PDF must equal 1.

definitions.title: Expected Value (Mean) of a Random Variable
definitions.statement: The mean or expected value of a continuous random variable X is the first moment of the probability density function with respect to the origin.
definitions.explanation: Analogous to the center of mass x_bar of a wire with density f(x).
definitions.keyTakeaway: The expected value is the probability-weighted average of all possible outcomes.
